metadata: document_id, source, page(unit), unit_id, section, pep_type, status, python_version, created_year, char_start/char_end
vectorizer: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384d, local CPU, normalized, cosine) + pgvector exact search
hypothesis: Baseline: short windows give precise matches for short factual questions but cut sentences/examples, hurting coherence and multi-sentence evidence.
notes: 460 chunks; 203,100 chars stored (~9% overlap duplication); 0 chunks over 256 tokens; coherence 0.9/2

chunking: by_paragraph (heading starts a chunk; paragraphs merged up to limit; oversize split by lines)
hypothesis: Changing ONLY chunking (A->B): structure-aware chunks keep whole ideas/sections, improving Hit@1, coherence and grounding; may dilute very short facts inside long chunks.
notes: 369 chunks; 1 chunk >256 tokens (truncated by model); coherence 1.7/2; tie with C on the pre-registered dev rule

filter: SQL WHERE pep_type = <value> only when the question carries a filter (5 questions: 3 dev, 2 test); otherwise identical to B
hypothesis: Changing ONLY the filter (B->C): restricting to the user-supplied PEP category removes off-scope chunks; expected to raise filter compliance and maybe Hit@k on ambiguous questions.
notes: filter compliance dev 3/3 (B 1/3), test 2/2 (B 1/2); no Hit@3 change on this benchmark; gold rank improved for d17 (16->12) and d18 (36->27)
